axis_ratio_contract.analysis_role: monotonic reparameterisation sensitivity of eccentricity; not an independent endpoint

meta.tile_area_note: density denominator is the full non-overlapping 256px tile area
meta.density_sensitivity_note: Reliable tissue-area correction is unavailable. The 48px JPEG atlas proxy failed blinded background QC and is not used as an effective-area denominator.
meta.axis_ratio_note: axis_ratio = 1/sqrt(1-eccentricity^2) is a monotonic reparameterisation sensitivity, not an independent morphology endpoint
meta.architecture_note: Tile-cluster composition is reported as one fraction per mouse; arm effects use the same exact two-sided 2-vs-2 mouse-label permutation and include explicit zero fractions.
meta.statistics_note: Mouse is the experimental unit. Exact p is two-sided over the six 2+2 mouse-label allocations and is emitted only for full 2x2 strata.
meta.aggregation_note: Tile-balanced is primary. Cell-weighted sensitivity weights per-tile fractions/quantiles by their contributing nucleus count; density remains total count divided by equal full-tile area.
meta.within_wsi_note: Raw mouse-by-cluster values are primary. Optional deviations use the equal mean of endpoint-eligible non-background strata within that mouse; this is a provisional technical reference, not pathologist-reviewed viable tumour. Cluster differences are descriptive and partly circular because clusters were learned from H&E morphology.

macro.interpretation: neutral technical macroregions; provisional and not pathologist reviewed

tissue_fraction_density.reason: blinded QC showed pure-white/background exemplars can have tissue_fraction_proxy near 0.94; the compressed 48px JPEG threshold is not a reliable tissue-area estimate
tissue_fraction_density.full_tile_density_interpretation: approximate counts per full tile area only; edge/background tiles are not tissue-area densities
